description: Sync your whole Datto BCDR fleet into local SQLite and answer the questions the per-appliance Partner Portal can't: which backups failed screenshot verification, which are stale, and which clients are at risk.

tools.name: agent_by-device
tools.description: List protected agents on a specific device. Required: serial. Optional: page (default: 1), per-page (default: 100). Returns array of Asset.

tools.name: agent_list
tools.description: List every protected agent across all devices. Optional: page (default: 1), per-page (default: 100). Returns array of Asset.

tools.name: alert_list
tools.description: List open alerts for a device. Required: serial. Optional: page (default: 1), per-page (default: 100). Returns array of Alert.

tools.name: asset_get
tools.description: Get a single asset by its volume name. Required: serial, volume. Returns the Asset.

params.name: volume
params.description: Asset volume name (GUID or share name)

tools.name: asset_list
tools.description: List all assets (agents + shares) on a device. Required: serial. Optional: page (default: 1), per-page (default: 100). Returns array of Asset.

tools.name: device_get
tools.description: Get a single BCDR device by serial number. Required: serial. Returns the Device.

tools.name: device_list
tools.description: List all BCDR devices in the partner account. Optional: page (default: 1), per-page (default: 100), show-hidden (plus 1 more). Returns array of Device.

params.name: show-hidden
params.description: Include hidden devices: '1' to show, '0' to omit

params.name: show-child-reseller
params.description: Include child-reseller devices: '1' to show, '0' to omit

tools.name: shares_list
tools.description: List protected shares on a device. Required: serial. Optional: page (default: 1), per-page (default: 100). Returns array of Asset.

tools.name: vm-restore_list
tools.description: List VM restore sessions on a device. Required: serial. Returns array of VMRestore.

novel_features.name: Fleet Screenshot Failures
novel_features.description: See every protected machine whose last backup-bootability screenshot failed, across your entire fleet, ranked by how long it's been failing and grouped by client.

novel_features.name: Client Risk Roll-up
novel_features.description: Per-client risk scorecard that rolls up screenshot failures, stale backups, open alerts, storage pressure, and warranty status into one ranked list of which clients are most at risk.

novel_features.name: Stale Backup Detector
novel_features.description: Find every agent whose last local snapshot or last offsite sync is older than a threshold, across all devices and clients at once.

novel_features.name: Orphaned & Paused Assets
novel_features.description: List agents that are paused or archived and devices that haven't checked in recently, across the whole fleet, so silently-unprotected machines and dead appliances get caught.

novel_features.name: Per-Client Recoverability Report
novel_features.description: One QBR-ready health report for a single client: devices, agents, screenshot pass rate, stale backups, and open alerts in one bundled view.

novel_features.name: Fleet Recoverability Scorecard
novel_features.description: One headline KPI: the percentage of fleet agents whose latest recovery point is both fresh and screenshot-verified bootable, with a breakdown of what drags it down.

novel_features.name: Fleet Alert Triage
novel_features.description: Every open alert across the whole fleet in one ranked view, grouped by client and device, instead of pulling alerts one appliance at a time.

novel_features.name: Storage Runway Forecast
novel_features.description: Rank every appliance by remaining local and offsite storage and flag the devices and clients closest to running out of capacity.

novel_features.name: Outdated Agent Fleet Audit
novel_features.description: Audit agent software versions across the entire fleet and flag every machine running an outdated agent, grouped by client and device.
